title: Your Contact List
drDigitalIntro:
A contact is a person you have saved in your phone or computer — their name, phone number, or email address, all in one place.
• The contacts list shows everyone you can message. Tap a name to open their conversation.
• Each conversation remembers everything you have ever said to that person.
• You do not have to send a message just because you open a conversation — you can just read it.
• New messages appear as a preview in the list so you can see who wrote without opening it.

playgroundTask.goal: Browse your contacts and read a few conversations

steps.say: Click on Alex to open the conversation and see their message.
Now click on Grandma to switch to her conversation.
Click on Sam to read their message.

drDigitalSuccess: You just browsed three different conversations without sending anything. The contact list is your address book — click any name to pick up where you left off.
drDigitalHint: Click a name in the left sidebar to open that conversation. You can switch between contacts any time.
